description: Add one or more clients (up to 100) to the signed-in advisor's firm, as the Clients page import does: name (required), email, countries, income types, asset classes, notes and tags. Countries and labels are put on Heed's lists ("UK" becomes United Kingdom); a client already on the roster is skipped. Heed then matches each client to the rule changes that touch them. Firm owners and admins only. This writes to the firm's real client list: read the clients back to the user and get a yes first. Nothing is sent to any client.

asset_classes.description: For example Equities/stocks, Real estate, Crypto, Bonds.

countries.description: Countries the client lives, works or holds assets in: names or two-letter codes.

email.description: Client's email, used to spot duplicates. Never emailed by this tool.

income_types.description: For example Employment salary, Dividends, Capital gains, Rental income.

tags.description: Free labels for the firm, for example HNWI or Founder.

name: add_clients
title: Add clients to the firm
